arguments.command:
cat <<'EOF' > .git/hooks/pre-commit
#!/bin/bash
# Run mypy on all Python files in src/
if ! command -v mypy &> /dev/null; then
    echo "mypy not found, skipping type check"
    exit 0
fi

mypy src
result=$?
if [ $result -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "Type checking failed, aborting commit."
    exit 1
fi
exit 0
EOF
chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
git add src/.py.typed .git/hooks/pre-commit && git commit -m 'release: v1.0.0'
